product_overview: Atlas is a bilingual, multi-tenant SaaS platform for launching and managing educational businesses. It provides authenticated experiences for platform owners, academy owners, instructors, and students, with role-aware navigation, academy management, course authoring, learning, billing, provisioning, website management, and public website delivery.
core_goals: Let users sign in and manage their own account and preferences
Let platform owners oversee platform-wide settings, billing, analytics, notifications, and search
Let academy owners create, configure, brand, and manage academies
Let course authors build and manage course content and settings
Let students discover courses, enroll, learn, submit work, and track progress
Let instructors manage teaching workflows, student progress, grading, announcements, and discussions
Let organizations manage subscriptions, usage, add-ons, payments, invoices, and trial policy
Let users request and track academy provisioning through an idempotent step-based flow
Let academy owners configure and preview their public website content, branding, and SEO
Let visitors browse published academy websites through hostname-based public routing

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in, register, request password resets, and restore their session through the auth flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/sign-in -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit registration form -> See account created state
Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit reset request -> See confirmation message
Navigate to /auth/reset-password -> Enter reset token -> Fill in new password -> Submit reset form -> See password updated state

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Authenticated users can land on a dashboard that summarizes their current workspace and navigate to other modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Land on overview -> See summary cards and recent activity -> Navigate to another module

features.name: User Profile & Settings
features.description: Users can view and edit their profile information, preferences, and password settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/profile -> Edit name or avatar -> Save changes -> See updated profile
Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Update notification preferences -> Save changes -> See updated preferences
Navigate to /dashboard/profile -> Enter current password and new password -> Submit password change -> See password updated state

features.name: Academy Management
features.description: Academy owners can create academies, edit academy details, manage branding, review members, and complete onboarding.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/academy -> View academy list -> Open an academy -> See academy overview
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/create -> Fill in academy details -> Submit creation form -> See onboarding start
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/profile -> Edit academy profile fields -> Save changes -> See updated academy profile
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/settings -> Update academy settings -> Save changes -> See updated academy settings
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/branding -> Change logo or colors -> Save changes -> See updated branding
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/members -> Search members -> Filter by role -> View member list
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/onboarding -> Step through onboarding checklist -> Complete steps -> See onboarding completed state

features.name: Course Management
features.description: Academy and instructor users can create, edit, organize, publish, and configure courses within a specific academy.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/courses -> View course list -> Search or filter courses -> Open a course
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/courses/create -> Fill in course title and description -> Submit course creation form -> See course editor
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/courses/:courseId -> Edit course details -> Save changes -> See updated course data
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/courses/:courseId/builder -> Add sections and lessons -> Reorder items -> See updated curriculum structure
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/courses/:courseId/settings -> Publish or unpublish the course -> Confirm action -> See updated publish state

features.name: Student Learning
features.description: Students can discover courses, enroll, learn through lessons, take quizzes, submit assignments, and monitor progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses -> Browse published courses -> Search or filter results -> Open course details
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId -> Review course details -> Enroll in course -> See enrollment confirmation
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId/learn/:lessonId -> Read lesson content -> Mark lesson complete -> See progress update
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId/quizzes/:quizId -> Answer quiz questions -> Submit attempt -> See quiz result
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId -> Write response -> Attach file if needed -> Submit assignment -> See submission state
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId/discussions -> Open forum -> Start or reply in a thread -> See discussion posted

features.name: Instructor Operations
features.description: Instructors can manage their assigned courses, review student progress, grade submissions, inspect quiz results, and post announcements.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/instructor -> See teaching overview -> Open a course -> See course summary
Navigate to /dashboard/instructor/courses/:courseId/students -> View student roster -> Open a student -> See progress details
Navigate to /dashboard/instructor/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/submissions -> Review submissions -> Open a submission -> Grade it with feedback
Navigate to /dashboard/instructor/courses/:courseId/quizzes/:quizId/results -> View quiz results -> Inspect attempt summaries -> See performance breakdown
Navigate to /dashboard/instructor/courses/:courseId/announcements -> Create an announcement -> Publish it -> See it appear in the feed
Navigate to /dashboard/instructor/courses/:courseId/discussions -> Moderate threads -> Pin or lock a thread -> See moderation state change

features.name: Community
features.description: Authenticated users can read announcements, write blog posts with permission, and participate in course discussions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/announcements -> Open feed -> Read an announcement -> See announcement detail
Navigate to /dashboard/blog -> Open post list -> Create or edit a post -> Publish the post -> See post detail
Navigate to /dashboard/learning/courses/:courseId/discussions/:threadId -> Read a discussion thread -> Reply to the thread -> See reply appear

features.name: Tenant Billing & Subscription
features.description: Tenant owners can review subscription plans, usage, add-ons, checkout flows, payments, and invoices.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/tenant -> See subscription overview -> Review current plan and trial status
Navigate to /dashboard/tenant/subscription -> Review plan details -> Compare entitlements -> See upgrade or add-on guidance
Navigate to /dashboard/tenant/usage -> Review usage meters -> See limit status and remaining capacity
Navigate to /dashboard/tenant/add-ons -> View active add-ons -> Purchase a compatible add-on -> See updated add-on state
Navigate to /dashboard/tenant/billing -> Start checkout for a plan or add-on -> Enter payment details or proof -> Submit payment -> See payment history update
Navigate to /dashboard/tenant/billing/invoices -> Open invoice list -> Review a specific invoice -> See invoice details

features.name: Provisioning
features.description: Tenant owners can request a new academy provisioned, watch its step-by-step status, and retry or cancel if needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/provisioning/new -> Enter academy name and subdomain -> Check availability -> Submit provisioning request -> See request created
Navigate to /dashboard/provisioning/:requestId -> Watch step progress -> Leave the page -> Return later -> See the same request state
Navigate to /dashboard/provisioning/:requestId -> See failed status -> Retry the request -> See progress resume
Navigate to /dashboard/provisioning -> Review provisioning history -> Open a completed request -> Go to the academy dashboard

features.name: Website Builder
features.description: Academy owners can manage website theme, branding, pages, navigation, SEO, content library references, and publish state.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website -> Review website overview -> Open settings or pages -> Continue editing
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website/settings -> Change theme or branding colors -> Save changes -> See updated draft
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website/pages -> Create a page -> Add sections -> Reorder sections -> Save draft
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website/content -> Add FAQ or testimonial entries -> Publish an entry -> See it available for page sections
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website/preview -> Preview the draft website -> Inspect layout on different breakpoints -> See the draft as it will publish
Navigate to /dashboard/academy/:academyId/website/settings -> Update navigation, header CTA, or SEO fields -> Publish website -> See published state

features.name: Public Website Runtime
features.description: Visitors can reach a published academy website on its hostname, browse published pages, and use real navigation links.
user_flows: Open a public academy hostname -> See the published website homepage -> Navigate through public pages
Open a public page URL -> Read metadata and content -> Click internal navigation or CTA links -> Reach the target page or course
Guess a draft or hidden page URL -> See that the page is not reachable publicly
Open a public website on a different hostname -> See that another academy's content does not appear

features.name: Notifications & Search
features.description: Users can browse notifications and search across the platform with keyboard support.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/notifications -> Review notifications -> Mark one as read -> See feed update
Navigate to /dashboard/search -> Type a query -> See grouped results -> Open a result
Press Cmd/Ctrl+K -> Open search -> Navigate results with arrow keys -> Activate a selected result

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Platform and academy users can review KPI tiles and charts for analytics views.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/analytics -> Select a date range -> View KPI cards and charts -> See updated analytics
Navigate within analytics tabs -> Switch metric views -> Review chart changes

features.name: Platform Admin Console
features.description: Platform owners can manage organizations, academies, users, roles, support cases, audit logs, plans, payment review, provisioning review, and platform domain or trial settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/platform -> Review platform overview -> Open a management section -> Inspect records
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/organizations -> Search organizations -> Open one organization -> See its detail
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/users -> Search users -> Open a user -> See user detail
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/support -> Open a support case -> Reply or change status -> See the case update
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/payments -> Review a payment -> Approve or reject it with notes -> See review state update
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/provisioning -> Open a provisioning request -> Retry or cancel it -> See updated request state
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/trial -> Update trial policy -> Save changes -> See updated platform policy
Navigate to /dashboard/platform/domain -> Review platform base domain status -> Update configuration -> See honest connection status

features.name: System Pages
features.description: Users can land on generic forbidden and not-found pages when access is denied or routes do not exist.
user_flows: Navigate to a protected route without permission -> See the forbidden page
Navigate to an unknown path -> See the not-found page

features.name: Public Marketing Site & Blog
features.description: Unauthenticated users can browse the marketing homepage, public blog, and academy public websites.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the marketing homepage -> See public marketing content
Open a public blog post -> Read the post -> Return to the blog index
Open a public academy website by hostname -> Browse published pages -> Follow public links

known_limitations.issue: Route guard fail-closed on permissions/roles redirects to /403 without a user-facing explanation of which permission was missing.
known_limitations.impact: Users denied access see a generic forbidden page with no actionable detail.

known_limitations.issue: VITE_API_BASE_URL is baked into the production build at build time (http://localhost:3000/api/v1 in this environment).
known_limitations.impact: Testing against a different backend host requires a rebuild, not just a runtime env change.

known_limitations.issue: Dev server default port (3000) collides with the backend's default port (3000).
known_limitations.impact: Running `npm run dev` and the backend simultaneously without overriding VITE_PORT will fail to bind.
